criterion.food-help.income-limit: Your income is under the limit for your household size
criterion.phone-discount.income-or-benef: Your income is under the limit, or you receive a qualifying benefit
criterion.senior-food.gross-limit: Your income is under the limit for your household size
criterion.utility-discount.housing: You rent or own your home
criterion.utility-discount.income-limit: Your income is under the limit
criterion.work-credit.income-limit: Your income is under the limit for your family
pack.zz-test.name: Demo rules
program.food-help.apply: Apply online, by phone or at the county office. An interview usually follows.
program.food-help.documents: Usually: identification, proof of address, and proof of income for the last month.
program.food-help.name: Test Food Help
program.food-help.renewal: It lasts several months and is renewed with a short form.
program.food-help.summary: A monthly benefit for buying food, loaded on a card, for households under an income limit.
program.phone-discount.apply: Apply through a participating phone or internet company, or with the program's own form.
program.phone-discount.documents: Usually: identification and proof of income, or proof of a benefit the household already receives.
program.phone-discount.name: Test Phone Discount
program.phone-discount.renewal: It is confirmed again once a year.
program.phone-discount.summary: A monthly discount on one phone or internet service per household.
program.senior-food.apply: Apply online, by phone or at the county office, with a shorter form.
program.senior-food.documents: Usually: identification, proof of age, and proof of income.
program.senior-food.name: Test Senior Food Path
program.senior-food.renewal: It lasts longer than regular food benefits before it is renewed.
program.senior-food.summary: A simpler way into food benefits for households where someone is 60 or older.
program.utility-discount.apply: Apply with a one-page form from the utility company, online or by mail.
program.utility-discount.documents: Usually only the account number from a bill. Proof of income may be asked for later.
program.utility-discount.name: Test Utility Discount
program.utility-discount.office: The customer service of the household's utility company
program.utility-discount.renewal: The discount is renewed every two years.
program.utility-discount.summary: A discount on the monthly electricity or gas bill for households under an income limit.
program.work-credit.apply: It is claimed on the yearly tax return. A free tax help site can file it with you.
program.work-credit.documents: Usually: proof of what you earned in the year, such as paystubs or a year-end wage statement, and identification for each person on the return.
program.work-credit.name: Test Work Credit
program.work-credit.renewal: It is claimed again each year.
program.work-credit.summary: A yearly credit for people who work and whose income is under a limit. It lowers the tax owed or is paid back as a refund.
question.benefits.help: Choose all that apply. Choose none if you receive none.
question.benefits.label: Which of these do you receive?
question.hasEarnedIncome.label: Did you earn money from a job or self-employment this year?
question.hasOlderMember.label: Is anyone in your home 60 or older?
question.householdSize.help: Count everyone who shares meals or rent with you.
question.householdSize.label: How many people live in your home, including you?
question.housing.label: Do you rent or own your home?
question.income.help: Before taxes. A range is enough for now.
question.income.label: About how much does your household earn in a year?
question.numChildren.label: How many children under 18 live with you?
question.residentStatus.help: In the demo rules this stands in for questions such as residency or tax ID type.
question.residentStatus.label: Do you meet the residency rule for these programs?
